name: Driving Simulator Malibu
summary:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - in Malibu.

THE CAR
A V12 sports car with a race cockpit: a racing wheel, bucket seats, a roll cage, shift lights across the dash and a live display behind the wheel. Grip the wheel, work the gear stick and pull the handbrake with your own hands - or drive with the joysticks.

A REAL 6-SPEED MANUAL
Move the stick through a real H-pattern: 1 3 5 up top, 2 4 6 underneath, reverse far right. Rev it to the shift lights and snap the next gear in. Prefer to cruise? Switch
